rules: No hashtags unless hashtags are allowed for this request.
No emoji unless the voice profile records the author using them.
No engagement bait such as "Thoughts?" or "Agree?".
No stock AI phrases such as "Here's the thing", "Let that sink in" or "game-changer".
No numbered thread markers such as "1/" or "(2/5)".
The first post of a thread must stand alone as a hook.
The first line is the hook: under about 80 characters, standing alone.
Short lines with a blank line between beats; no wall of text.
No links in the post; a source goes in the first reply.
